title: round 4 voided because I committed while the review was running
blast_reasoning: No repo damage; the round produced findings that were verified by hand, but its evidence is not usable.
approaches: treat the round as VOID and re-run cleanly (taken)
accept the verdict anyway (REJECTED — the reviewer read a moving repo)
reviewer_findings: Wrapper VOID: HEAD moved 5e102f38 -> 2aad6389 mid-review. Tree hash identical on both sides, so the reviewer changed nothing — the mutation was mine.
immunisation: The tree control caught it, which is the control working. Standing rule now: do not commit to the repo while a review is in flight; the reviewer must read one fixed commit.
reason: The VOID message said 'the reviewer mutated the repository', which was wrong in attribution and right in conclusion. The real defect is worse than the one it named: the reviewer read a repo that changed under it, so its findings cannot be bound to a single state. Findings were still legible and were verified by hand before acting.

reviewer_findings: 'It substantially mitigates G1 for server-rendered navigation; it does not close all route existence. The declared gaps are accurate.'

'Closing G1 did not weaken C9 or auth coverage in the observed runs.'

title: providers read-only half PASSED cross-vendor review, round 1

reviewer_findings: No spec findings.
Vault claim holds, and sharpened: credentials_vault is reached ONLY by the POST registration path (route.ts:69), never by GET.

Rebuilt provider-usage route does not leak key values: env keys are checked as booleans via typeof/length at provider-usage.ts:237; payload carries ids, labels, state, percentages, summary, routing only; error response is fixed text.

title: LIVE: production /api/telegram accepts anonymous POSTs and returns output to attacker-chosen chat
blast_reasoning: Production dashboard pi-dev-ops (unite-group). Both fail-open conditions live simultaneously: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET unset (old check fired only on a PRESENTED mismatch) and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID unset (isAuthorized returned true for any chat id). TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN IS set, so send() delivers. An anonymous POST could supply its own chat.id, run bot commands, and receive output in its own chat — including /status, which reaches upstream with PI_CEO_PASSWORD.
approaches: IMMEDIATE, no deploy needed: set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID in Vercel production. Under the CURRENT deployed code that alone stops output reaching an attacker-chosen chat.
Setting TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET alone does NOT help on deployed code — the old check still skips when the header is omitted.
FULL closure needs the hardening deployed (fail-closed secret + fail-closed allowlist).
reviewer_findings: Round-1 hardening review confirmed the pre-fix control flow reading: with TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID unset a forged /status could use the supplied chat id and send output back through send().
immunisation: Fix exists on feat/command-centre-migration (fail-closed webhook secret + fail-closed isAuthorized) with tests proven red against the vulnerable code. NOT DEPLOYED: main is untouched at 9f3be6ec.
gated_on: FOUNDER: (1) set TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID now as immediate mitigation; (2) rotation decision on TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and on whether PI_CEO_PASSWORD-backed upstream data is considered exposed; (3) deploy decision for the hardening branch. Credential changes and production deploys are not auto-executed.
exposure_window: UNKNOWN upper bound. TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN was created 117d ago; the route's deployment date was not established. Treat as up to 117 days until the deployment timeline is checked.
note: Env metadata only was read (names, targets, created-ago). No values were retrieved and no request was sent to the live endpoint — probing it would have meant exercising the vulnerability.

title: main will carry two session verifiers with nothing watching once PR #603 merges
blast_reasoning: No exploitable defect: both verifiers implement the same check. The risk is DIVERGENCE over time, which is exactly what lib/auth-secret.ts was created to prevent after login once succeeded while every protected page bounced.
approaches: accept the duplication for a few days and ship the security fix (taken)
consolidate inside the hotfix (REJECTED — enlarges a change set going in front of a live system under time pressure)
reviewer_findings: Round-1 hardening review flagged the duplication: 'the structural claim that the verifier is shared is false, and the proxy copy lacks the shared function's try/catch'.
immunisation: dashboard/__tests__/session-verifier-single-source.test.ts asserts every session-verification caller resolves to lib/auth-secret.ts. It is GREEN on feat/command-centre-migration where consolidation landed, and RED against the hotfix branch's proxy.ts — verified by swapping that file in. It does NOT run in PR #603.
gated_on: Clears when feat/command-centre-migration lands, which removes the local verifier AND brings the tripwire into CI on main.
reason: Recorded as a dated obligation rather than a thing discovered and moved past. Until the feature branch lands, main has an unwatched duplication of the check that decides whether a request is authenticated. Do not resolve it by exempting or softening the tripwire when it arrives.

title: VERIFIED CLOSED on production - both unauthenticated inbound paths refuse
blast_reasoning: Closed now; ran 117 days.
immunisation: kill-switch-auth.test.ts (8) and telegram-webhook-auth.test.ts (7), both proven RED against the unfixed code. api-auth-classification.test.ts prevents the omission class recurring.
verification: OBSERVED on production, not inferred from the diff. Deployment dpl_HQBxASpsZgEZeBaH4WiQ5fVGSWQs, state READY, target production, commit 8fd7fdfa, built 2026-08-02T13:54:47. POST /api/telegram with no secret -> 403 Forbidden (old code returned 200). POST /api/kill-switch?op=probe with no credential -> 401 Unauthorised (400 would have proved the guard absent). Those responses also prove the NEW code is serving, since the old code answered 200 and 400.
kill_switch_secret: INFERRED BOUND, NOT OBSERVED. The variable exists in project production env and the serving deployment was built after it was set, so it inherits it. Externally indistinguishable from unbound: a correctly-guarded route returns 401 whether the secret is bound-and-wrong or absent. Only a request carrying the correct value would prove it, and the value was deliberately never read.
exposure_window: 117 days, 2026-04-07 to 2026-08-02. Route landed on main 2026-04-07; fail-open secret check 2026-04-10; isAuthorized fail-open 2026-04-14, and before that no chat restriction existed at all. Corroborated by TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN created 117 days prior.
abuse_determination: CANNOT DETERMINE. Vercel runtime logs queryable at 6h, time out at 7d, ExceedsBillingLimitError at 30d. Hours of retention against a 117-day window.
lesson: FIXED IS NOT DEPLOYED, and the estate had no check that would have said so. The fix existed on a branch for HOURS while production stayed vulnerable, and every local signal was green throughout: gate pass=8 fail=0, controls 22/22, suites passing. Every one measured the BRANCH. Nothing measured what production was serving. Inverse of shipped-is-not-observed, and it needs its own control: compare the deployed artifact's BEHAVIOUR against the fix it is supposed to contain.

title: admin override used to merge PR #603
blast_reasoning: A protected-branch requirement was bypassed. Justified here, but bypasses must be countable or the habit is invisible.
override_reason: Live security incident: two unauthenticated inbound paths open in production for 117 days. The review requirement is UNSATISFIABLE BY CONSTRUCTION here - 1 approving review required, sole collaborator, and GitHub forbids a PR author approving their own PR. There was no path to an approval, so the override was the only mechanism available, not a shortcut chosen over one.
reviewer_findings: No APPROVED review existed. The only review on #603 was COMMENTED from coderabbitai.
structural_finding: A control that can never fire is not a control. As configured, EVERY PR authored by the sole collaborator must be merged by admin override, which trains the bypass into muscle memory and leaves no trace. That is how PR #218 happens again with a human hand on it rather than an agent's.
design_fix_later: Give the cross-vendor reviewer a GitHub App identity that can APPROVE but holds NO write access, founder remaining the only party who can merge. Makes the review requirement satisfiable without letting the reviewer land code. NOT to be built now.
countability: Schema for counting overrides: class=governance-override with override_type, override_by, override_reason.
